comments.content: SHIPPED — multi-agent Forge sessions. The concurrency-safety primitive is EMERGENT: cache::store atomic (temp+rename, #8), load degrades torn entries to MISS (#49). forge/tests/concurrency.rs (7 tests): N=8 concurrent forge PROCESSES over a shared cache -> correct certs (oracle-subset == serial == golden), no corruption; per-item LOCALITY (editing A never invalidates B unless B references A — §5.3/§9, with negative control); torn->MISS; concurrent==serial. No central daemon. Critic NO DIVERGENCE (genuinely concurrent, store atomic stress-probed, locality genuine, no flakiness 3x). Commit e0e930b. workspace 365 tests, clippy/fmt clean. Filed #53 (verus-temp leak). Not pushed.
